subject: geom_density as a line (not a closed polygon)?

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: geom_density as a line (not a closed polygon)?
parts:
Currently geom_density creates a closed polygon (plotted in red
below); is there any way to make it a single line as in the normal
density function (plotted in green below)?

a = data.frame(obs = test_data,condition = 'None')
p = ggplot(
data = a
,aes(
x = obs
)
)+geom_histogram(
aes(
y = ..density..
)
)+geom_density(
colour='red'
)+stat_function(
fun = dnorm
,args = list(
m=mean(a$obs)
,sd=sd(a$obs)
)
,colour = 'green'
)

--

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: geom_density as a line (not a closed polygon)?
parts:
Hi,

it seems you can do the following,

m <- ggplot(movies, aes(x=rating))
m + stat_density(mapping=aes(ymax=1),geom="path")

I'm not quite sure about the meaning of ymax though.

Alternatively you could overwrite the bottom line with an horizontal
line of the same colour as the grid and axes (this way you can still
use a fill colour).


HTH,

baptiste

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: geom_density as a line (not a closed polygon)?
parts:
The error message is a better guide to what the real problem is -
stat_density defaults to position stack which doesn't make sense for
lines. This is a better alternative:

m + stat_density(geom="path", position="identity")

Hadley
